_note: Hugging Face sources for G0. Revisions are resolved from 'main' at download time and recorded (commit sha) in tools/reference/gemma/gemma_manifest.json. Pass --source-revision / --official-revision to pin an exact commit.
source_repo_note: As named in the project spec. Google also publishes google/gemma-3-4b-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized, whose QAT targets Q4_0 (GGUF / llama.cpp); the int4 checkpoint targets general int4 schemes. Open decision for the project owner, see tools/gemma/README.md.
official_gguf_file_note: Text model only. The repo also holds the vision projector (mmproj); it is out of scope and never downloaded. If this filename is not in the repo, the pipeline stops and lists the repo's .gguf files.

perplexity_text.source: llama.cpp b11201 scripts/get-wikitext-2.sh (the standard llama.cpp perplexity text)
